title: Introspective Coupling: Self-Explanation Training Tracks Behavioral Change Despite Fixed Supervision

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual evaluation of model answers to determine if responses change when user-suggested hints are present (Hint-MMLU dataset) or when flattery-inducing narrative framings are used (AITA dataset).
Counterfactual evaluation of model refusal behaviors to test if the model's willingness to comply with or refuse a prompt changes based on the user's stated role or profession in the system prompt.
